scope: Chromium phone emulation at 320px and 390px in light and dark themes; native device testing deferred.

layoutCoverage.320px: Every public chart demo in both themes
layoutCoverage.390px: First demo of every chart in both themes

checks: Retention through 7.5 seconds and dismissal after 8 seconds
Tooltip stays near chart and inside viewport
Network and Sankey links expose values
Heatmap cells fit inside preview bounds

visualReview: Reviewed chart contact sheets, selected-value screenshots, dark-theme previews, and dense examples; inspected all seven narrow Heatmap demos after correcting cell layout.
findingsResolved: RadialBarChart omitted inner rings when fixed thickness and gaps exceeded available space; all rings now fit with room for the center readout.
MarimekkoChart wrapped titles overlapped the plot; default padding now reserves the measured title band.
Heatmap labels overflowed small cells; labels now require enough space, with full values in tooltips.
Heatmap cell scaling did not reserve fixed gap widths, clipping columns; the width budget now excludes gaps before scaling.
Narrow Heatmap rows became too short despite spare vertical room; row height now stays at least 24px when requested height and available space permit.
Bar value labels clipped or overlapped; labels are omitted when they cannot fit.
Scatter quadrant captions overlapped on narrow charts; details move to point tooltips, which now honor the supplied formatter.
Violin statistic labels overlapped between distributions; compact charts retain markers and reveal the configured statistics in tooltips.
Pie, Funnel and Candlestick touch tooltips did not consistently expire; touch source detection and expiry now follow the shared eight-second duration.
Bubble, Combo and Pareto tooltip anchors jumped after release; retained selections now keep the last pointer position.
Unnamed Sparkline tooltips exposed generated series identifiers; they now use the label Value.

validation.desktopBaselineNote: The 84 desktop reference images were absent from this checkout and were regenerated; a subsequent comparison passed.
